# Agent instructions for this branch

This branch publishes private-share artifacts through GitHub Pages.

## Branch purpose

- Branch: `gh-pages`
- App entry point: `index.html`
- Share paths live under: `s/<hash>/`
- Directory archives live at: `s/<hash>.zip`
- Share index file: `sessions.jsonl`

## Required commit behavior

Agents MUST keep commits small and direct.

When adding a share, agents MUST:

1. Add the share entry point at `s/<hash>/index.html`.
2. Put related share files under `s/<hash>/`.
3. Add `s/<hash>.zip` only for a directory share.
4. Add one JSONL record to `sessions.jsonl`.
5. Keep each `sessions.jsonl` line valid JSON.
6. Use relative paths from the repository root.
7. Verify that `index.html` can read the new entry.

Required JSONL format:

```jsonl
{"hash":"abc123def456","date":"2026-06-23T14-30-00Z","path":"s/abc123def456/","title":"Build session index","kind":"html"}
```

Directory shares MUST include `zipPath`:

```jsonl
{"hash":"abc123def456","date":"2026-06-23T14-30-00Z","path":"s/abc123def456/","zipPath":"s/abc123def456.zip","title":"Build session index","kind":"directory"}
```

Rules:

- `hash` MUST contain 12 to 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
- `path` MUST equal `s/<hash>/`.
- `zipPath` MUST equal `s/<hash>.zip` when present.
- `date` MUST use `YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ`.
- `title` MUST be human-readable.
- `kind` MUST be `html`, `file`, or `directory`.

## Commit message format

Use terse commit messages:

- `add share: <short-name>`
- `update share index`
- `fix share index app`

## Do not

Agents MUST NOT rewrite existing share files unless fixing a known broken share.
Agents MUST NOT remove entries from `sessions.jsonl` unless deleting the matching share.
Agents MUST NOT commit unrelated project files to this branch.
Agents MUST NOT force-push.

## Validation

Before committing, agents MUST run:

```bash
node scripts/validate-sessions-index.mjs
```

The validator checks:

- `sessions.jsonl` exists.
- Every non-empty, non-comment line is valid JSON.
- Every record has `hash`, `date`, `path`, `title`, and `kind`.
- Every record points to `s/<hash>/index.html`.
- Every directory record points to `s/<hash>.zip`.
- No hash appears more than once.

If validation cannot be completed, agents MUST say what was not verified.
